title: pane.last_output
description: Returns the output of the pane's last command as plain text, as pane.read does: from the shell's OSC 133 C mark to the D mark after it, or to the end while the command runs. Program output can fake the marks. A pane with no marks is refused. Needs hello version 2, and for now the pane must be the caller's own (the self scope).

pane.description: The pane's number, which must be the caller's own.
